categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Fuzzing label and adds a new fuzz harness in src/test/fuzz/p2p_transport_serialization.cpp.
categories.rationale: Adds fuzz coverage for BIP 324 V2Transport error handling and post-handshake state transitions against arbitrary byte streams. The description notes that 'no fuzz target feeds V2Transport bytes that an honest peer would not send past the v2 key exchange', addressing an unexercised attack surface for hostile peer traffic.
